sourceProvenance.sourceImport: Pinned upstream f43dd94 plus deliberate local P3 context-bound Gateway, strict ingress, ordered observer and official Stage registration patches, and local P5 bounded native DAVE voice cutover. NOT unmodified upstream or a claimed upstream release. Independent module/example manifest edits are outside this SDK-package census.
sourceProvenance.catalogKind: Reviewed source inventory only; not protobuf/converter/runtime verification
sourceProvenance.sdkCommitScope: sdkCommit/sdkVersion/sdkUpstreamTree identify the pinned upstream base only, not the patched local source tree.

localSourcePatches.P3: Context-aware shared Gateway lifecycle/writers; bounded ingress and callback join; ordered raw host observer and detached Before snapshots; uppercase STAGE_INSTANCE_* registration; corrected API/voice endpoint initialization. Parent-approved Go1.27 vet correction uses a literal %s format for ErrUnauthorized informational logging in RequestWithLockedBucket; no module API/behavior change. Parent-assigned Message.UnmarshalJSON partial-components correction preserves omitted nil versus present empty slice, avoiding implicit cache component deletion on partial MESSAGE_UPDATE.
localSourcePatches.P5: Bounded context-native voice API/engine with DAVE under voice+cgo; ordinary unsupported backend; private credential dispatch and immutable Opus handoff; removed legacy ChannelVoiceJoin/speaking/channel/UDP paths. Parent-assigned crypto review separates reset/proposal/prepared-ID deadlines and binds pending-reset authorization to authenticated opcode24 epoch1 plus current generation/version/successful opcode26 write; deferred opcode25 may complete matching unconsumed authorization. Native crypto ABI/patch remains unchanged.

sourceProvenance.canonicalModule: github.com/chatanium/discordgo; version and checksum come from the consuming Go module, not the historical upstream sdkVersion field
sourceProvenance.canonicalImportReview: voice_gateway.go and voice_transport.go import the canonical module's internal/dave package. These import-only changes update the active source hashes; upstream-base identity and historical baseline/audit records are unchanged. discordgo/ source identities are stable inventory labels, not local checkout paths.
sourceProvenance.publicationSourceReview: Published v0.30.0 incorporates gofmt doc-comment layout changes in logging.go and oauth2.go; the five reviewed Application method documentation fingerprints follow those comments without changing signatures, bodies, defaults or classifications. voice.go's active fingerprint corrects an already stale pin to the byte-identical source in main commit 3158838b78dd92cb8220673cc4887d009204ef1a. Historical snapshots and audits remain unchanged.
sourceProvenance.retirementSourceReview: The published voice.go matches existing main source but active inventories lagged its retirement handshake. VoiceConnection.leaveAck and leaveConfirmed are private runtime-only state: ordered null-channel observation closes the acknowledgement; DisconnectContext waits within CloseTimeout, joins confirmation errors, and retains the reservation until cleanup and confirmation. Two extra anonymous empty struct channel types are implementation-local. Other nested identity changes and public declaration fingerprints are source-position shifts plus the separately reviewed OAuth documentation formatting; no module exposure changes.
sourceProvenance.sourceFormatting: Parent-applied final SDK formatting incorporated into exact frozen source byte hashes. Pinned upstream f43dd94 plus reviewed local P3/P5 corrections; no semantic reformatting or SDK edits performed by the inventory owner.
